newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan temperatures seen normal from July 12-Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: Japan temperatures seen normal from July 12-Aug 11.

text.p: Japan's temperatures from July 12 to August 11 are likely to be about the same as the usual year, the Meteorological Agency said on Friday.
It also said in its monthly forecast that rainfall and sunshine were likely to be about normal for the period.
In a week-by-week breakdown, the agency said normal temperatures were expected for July 12 to 18.

The week of July 19 to 25 is likely to see lower-than-average temperatures in northern and eastern Japan, and about the same temperatures as the usual year in western Japan and the southwestern islands.
Temperatures during the two weeks from July 26 to August 8 are expected to be normal for the period, the agency said.
